source_title: Final Fantasy Resonance: How to Get More Magicite - GameRant
source_excerpt:
Magicite in Final Fantasy Resonance is an important item for powering up your Visions. They can be found in multiple places, given as rewards for chests, and received from defeating certain enemies. You'll want to get every magicite shard, magicite, and magicite cryst to unlock the full potential of all your visions. This guide shows every magicite location in Final Fantasy Resonance , and alternate ways to get them.
How to get Every Magicite Shard, Magicite, and Magicite Cryst
Magicite Shards are used to awaken Visions in Final Fantasy Resonance . This will level up your visions from 1–3 Stars and unlock new abilities and bonuses. There are 3 types of "Magicite" items :
Magicite Shards - Unlocks 1-Star Awakening.
Magicite - Unlocks 2-Star Awakening.
Magicite Crysts - Unlocks 3-Star Awakening.
The sections below have tables with the information about the chapter and location, how to get it, and a screenshot, if applicable, of each type of magicite.
